q-75356.name: Question 2
q-75356.problem: What is $\frac{3x+9z}{6x-15z}$ reduced to its lowest terms?
q-75356.worked_solution:
We factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any factors that they have in common.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3x+9z}{6x-15z} & =\frac{3(x+3z)}{3(2x-5z)} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{3}\cdot (x+3z)}{\cancel{3}\cdot (2x-5z)} \\  & =\frac{x+3z}{2x-5z}\end{aligned}
$$

q-52369.name: Question 3
q-52369.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{-4x+12}{3x-9}?$
q-52369.worked_solution:
We factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any factors that they have in common.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{-4x+12}{3x-9} & =\frac{-4(x-3)}{3(x-3)} \\  & =\frac{-4\cancel{(x-3)}}{3\cancel{(x-3)}} \\  & =\frac{-4}{3} \\  & =-\frac{4}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

q-51522.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{10t+12}{15t+18}?$
q-51522.worked_solution:
We factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any factors that they have in common.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{10t+12}{15t+18} & =\frac{2(5t+6)}{3(5t+6)} \\  & =\frac{2\cancel{(5t+6)}}{3\cancel{(5t+6)}} \\  & =\frac{2}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

q-41531.name: Question 7
q-41531.problem: What is $\frac{4ab-8+10x}{10x+8-2ab}$ reduced to its lowest terms?
q-41531.worked_solution:
We factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any factors that they have in common.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{4ab-8+10x}{10x+8-2ab} & =\frac{2(2ab-4+5x)}{2(5x+4-ab)} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{2}(2ab-4+5x)}{\cancel{2}(5x+4-ab)} \\  & =\frac{2ab-4+5x}{5x+4-ab}\end{aligned}
$$

q-57786.name: Question 8
q-57786.problem: What is $\frac{8a-4b+12}{20b+8a}$ reduced to its lowest terms?
q-57786.worked_solution:
We factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any factors that they have in common.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{8a-4b+12}{20b+8a} & =\frac{4(2a-b+3)}{4(5b+2a)} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{4}(2a-b+3)}{\cancel{4}(5b+2a)} \\  & =\frac{2a-b+3}{5b+2a}\end{aligned}
$$
